hook: Gary Marcus is a cognitive scientist and Professor Emeritus of Psychology and Neural Science at New York University, and one of the best known critics of how today's AI systems are built. He founded the machine learning startup Geometric Intelligence, which Uber acquired in 2016, and then directed Uber AI Labs. He later founded the robotics company Robust.AI, and his books include Rebooting AI with Ernest Davis.

quick_facts: Professor Emeritus of Psychology and Neural Science at NYU, where he was appointed in 1997, according to his LinkedIn profile
Founder and CEO of Geometric Intelligence from June 2015 to December 2016, when it was acquired by Uber
Director of Uber AI Labs from December 2016 to March 2017
Founder and executive chairman of Robust.AI, from June 2019 to July 2021 on his profile
Author of books including Rebooting AI (with Ernest Davis), Guitar Zero, The Algebraic Mind, Kluge and The Birth of the Mind
PhD in cognitive science from MIT
